Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo + dedicated capacity sizing session

Hi Samira / BlueWave team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single thread to reference: 

- What we heard: you plan to pilot real-time document classification + summarization for customer support, targeting ~250 qps at peak for short conversations (~256 token context) with occasional bursts to 400 qps. Latency target is p95 < 150ms for generation.
- Why Redwood fits: our Dedicated offering supports predictable throughput and prefix KV caching to keep tail latency consistent; we should validate exact QPS and token-distribution in the sizing call.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Scheduling a 60–75 minute dedicated capacity sizing & technical deep-dive with your infra and SREs (we'll bring a solutions engineer).
2) Prior to that call, please share a small representative load profile (CSV or sample traces) — we can accept anonymized logs.
3) We'll walk through an intake sheet and run a sizing playbook (we'll bring model variant and quantization options).

Can you confirm the right attendees on your side (SRE, platform/security, and the analytics lead)? I included Lauren (solutions) and Irene (ops) on Cc to join the sizing session.

I put a tentative 2-hour window in our Calendly link (below) — if you prefer a few fixed windows, send options and we'll lock.

Attachments: intake template (redwood-dedicated-intake.xlsx) attached for your convenience.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

- Validate mapping from our latency SLOs to GPU pool sizing (especially for p95/p99)
- Discuss autoscaling/burst behavior and warm-up KV cache expectations
- Quantization options and likely model variants for our workload (we currently run a 13B baseline)

Proposed windows (PST): Thurs Nov 4 10:00–11:15, Fri Nov 5 09:00–10:30, or Mon Nov 8 14:00–15:15. Any of these work for your team?
